subject: Re: Follow up on our meeting
text:
Data-
- Personal information - email, profile image.
- Data enrichment - such as employer and job title for a better app experience

Encryption and leak prevention -
- Save all our PII data encrypted with recognized encryption protocols
- All data is being encrypted on data transit by recognized encryption protocols
- Data access is restricted only to a minimal number of employees by approval for maintenance only.
- Data access is protected by the best authentication method and access standards such as SSO 2fa
- Data is hosted at Google data centers and runs on Google Cloud Platform technology. These data centers, located in the US and the EU, provide physical security 24/7.

Data rights and honor
We honor the data subject's rights and we will delete or provide the data of a data subject upon request.

text:
Hi Will,

Thanks for sending over the proposal and package details.

We’re aiming to grow to around 200 seats by the end of the year, but since
that’s a big spend for us as a startup, we’d like to start smaller. I’m
thinking we kick things off with 10 seats for the Annotate platform on a
1-quarter contract. This would give us the chance to show our board the
value of in-house labeling and your platform before committing to a bigger
rollout.

We’re also looking at a couple of other platforms right now, so this pilot
would help us compare and make the call as we scale our team. If all goes
well — and the Index features get implemented — we’d be interested in
moving to an annual agreement on the full platform and scaling up quickly.

What do you think?

Best,
Claire

subject: Re: Encord/Cohere Meeting - Context
text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the context! I'll go over some multimodal needs here and we can
chat thru the rest next week.

We're actively looking for curated image and audio data in the
following languages. This is listed by priority:

   1. Image caption data - Japanese and Korean
   2.  Audio transcription data - Japanese and Arabic
   3.  Audio transcription data - French, German, Spanish and Portuguese

Would love to understand your areas of expertise otherwise. At the moment
we need more curated datasets rather than annotation workforce or help.

Also attaching our mutual NDA form. If this looks good please send me a
signed copy.
